title: Lower bound on the code width
statement: Let $N$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, with $k$ work tapes and a finite state set $Q$. Set $h=3(|Q|+1)$ and $K=2(h+3k+1)+2$. For every natural number $c_0$, one has $c_0\le K(c_0+1)$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, with $k$ work tapes
